<tool_call>{"name": "animation_3js_createScene", "arguments": {"session_id": "d1db88cd-9c81-43ba-8952-4f5539f7dcfc", "file_name": "brain_simulation.html", "description": "Interactive 3D brain simulation with neurons, synaptic connections, and traveling neural impulses", "code": "
// Scene setup
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x050510);
scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x050510, 0.02);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 0, 45);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Controls
const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;
controls.autoRotate = true;
controls.autoRotateSpeed = 0.5;

// Lights
const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404060, 0.5);
scene.add(ambientLight);

const pointLight1 = new THREE.PointLight(0x4488ff, 1, 100);
pointLight1.position.set(20, 20, 20);
scene.add(pointLight1);

const pointLight2 = new THREE.PointLight(0xff4488, 1, 100);
pointLight2.position.set(-20, -20, 20);
scene.add(pointLight2);

// Brain parameters
const NEURON_COUNT = 600;
const CONNECTION_DISTANCE = 4.5;
const MAX_CONNECTIONS = 5;

const neurons = [];
const connections = [];
const impulses = [];

// Generate brain-shaped neuron positions
function generateBrainShape() {
    const positions = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < NEURON_COUNT; i++) {
        let x, y, z, r;
        let attempts = 0;
        do {
            // Spherical coordinates with brain-like distortion
            const u = Math.random();
            const v = Math.random();
            const theta = 2 * Math.PI * u;
            const phi = Math.acos(2 * v - 1);
            
            // Brain ellipsoid shape
            const a = 14; // width
            const b = 10; // height
            const c = 12; // depth
            
            x = a * Math.sin(phi) * Math.cos(theta);
            y = b * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta) * 0.9; // slightly flattened bottom
            z = c * Math.cos(phi);
            
            // Add some noise for organic look
            x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            z += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
            
            // Longitudinal fissure (split between hemispheres)
            if (x > -1 && x < 1) {
                x = x > 0 ? x + 1.5 : x - 1.5;
            }
            
            r = Math.sqrt((x/a)**2 + (y/b)**2 + (z/c)**2);
            attempts++;
        } while (r > 1 && attempts < 50);
        
        positions.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z));
    }
    return positions;
}

const positions = generateBrainShape();

// Region colors
const regionColors = [
    new THREE.Color(0x00aaff), // frontal - blue
    new THREE.Color(0x00ffaa), // parietal - teal
    new THREE.Color(0xffaa00), // temporal - orange
    new THREE.Color(0xff00aa), // occipital - pink
    new THREE.Color(0xaaff00), // cerebellum - lime
];

function getRegionColor(pos) {
    const normalizedY = (pos.y + 10) / 20;
    const normalizedZ = (pos.z + 12) / 24;
    const normalizedX = (pos.x + 14) / 28;
    
    if (normalizedY > 0.7) return regionColors[0]; // top = frontal
    if (normalizedZ < 0.3) return regionColors[3]; // back = occipital
    if (normalizedY < 0.3 && normalizedZ > 0.4) return regionColors[4]; // bottom back = cerebellum
    if (Math.abs(normalizedX - 0.5) > 0.3) return regionColors[2]; // sides = temporal
    return regionColors[1]; // middle = parietal
}

// Create neurons
const neuronGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.35, 16, 16);
const neuronMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({
    shininess: 80,
    specular: 0x444444
});

positions.forEach((pos, i) => {
    const color = getRegionColor(pos);
    const material = neuronMaterial.clone();
    material.color = color;
    material.emissive = color.clone().multiplyScalar(0.3);
    
    const neuron = new THREE.Mesh(neuronGeometry, material);
    neuron.position.copy(pos);
    
    // Add slight glow
    const glowGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.6, 16, 16);
    const glowMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: color,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.15
    });
    const glow = new THREE.Mesh(glowGeometry, glowMaterial);
    neuron.add(glow);
    
    neuron.userData = {
        id: i,
        activity: Math.random() * 0.5,
        targetActivity: Math.random(),
        glowMesh: glow,
        baseColor: color.clone()
    };
    
    scene.add(neuron);
    neurons.push(neuron);
});

// Create connections (synapses)
const lineMaterial = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({
    color: 0x445566,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.25
});

for (let i = 0; i < neurons.length; i++) {
    let connectionCount = 0;
    const distances = [];
    
    for (let j = i + 1; j < neurons.length; j++) {
        const dist = neurons[i].position.distanceTo(neurons[j].position);
        if (dist < CONNECTION_DISTANCE) {
            distances.push({ index: j, distance: dist });
        }
    }
    
    distances.sort((a, b) => a.distance - b.distance);
    
    for (let k = 0; k < Math.min(distances.length, MAX_CONNECTIONS); k++) {
        const j = distances[k].index;
        const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints([
            neurons[i].position,
            neurons[j].position
        ]);
        
        const line = new THREE.Line(geometry, lineMaterial.clone());
        scene.add(line);
        
        connections.push({
            line: line,
            neuronA: i,
            neuronB: j,
            active: false,
            activityTimer: 0
        });
        connectionCount++;
    }
}

// Impulse/pulse geometry
const impulseGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.2, 8, 8);
const impulseMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
    color: 0xffffff,
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.9
});

function createImpulse(connectionIndex, direction) {
    const conn = connections[connectionIndex];
    const material = impulseMaterial.clone();
    material.color = neurons[conn.neuronA].userData.baseColor.clone().lerp(
        new THREE.Color(0xffffff), 0.7
    );
    
    const impulse = new THREE.Mesh(impulseGeometry, material);
    impulse.userData = {
        connection: connectionIndex,
        progress: direction > 0 ? 0 : 1,
        direction: direction,
        speed: 0.02 + Math.random() * 0.03
    };
    
    scene.add(impulse);
    impulses.push(impulse);
}

// Mouse interaction
const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
let hoveredNeuron = null;

function onMouseMove(event) {
    mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
    mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
}
window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove, false);

window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
    camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
    camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});

// Animation
let time = 0;

function animate() {
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    time += 0.016;
    
    // Update controls
    controls.update();
    
    // Randomly fire impulses
    if (Math.random() < 0.15 && impulses.length < 80) {
        const randomConn = Math.floor(Math.random() * connections.length);
        createImpulse(randomConn, Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1);
    }
    
    // Update impulses
    for (let i = impulses.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const imp = impulses[i];
        const conn = connections[imp.userData.connection];
        imp.userData.progress += imp.userData.speed * imp.userData.direction;
        
        if (imp.userData.progress >= 1 || imp.userData.progress <= 0) {
            // Impulse reached target - light up neuron
            const targetNeuron = imp.userData.direction > 0 ? conn.neuronB : conn.neuronA;
            neurons[targetNeuron].userData.activity = 1.0;
            
            scene.remove(imp);
            impulses.splice(i, 1);
            continue;
        }
        
        const posA = neurons[conn.neuronA].position;
        const posB = neurons[conn.neuronB].position;
        imp.position.lerpVectors(posA, posB, imp.userData.progress);
        
        // Trail effect
        imp.material.opacity = 0.9 - imp.userData.progress * 0.3;
    }
    
    // Update neurons
    neurons.forEach(neuron => {
        // Decay activity
        neuron.userData.activity *= 0.95;
        
        // Occasional random firing
        if (Math.random() < 0.002) {
            neuron.userData.activity = 1.0;
        }
        
        const activity = neuron.userData.activity;
        
        // Pulse size based on activity
        const scale = 1 + activity * 0.4;
        neuron.scale.setScalar(scale);
        
        // Brighten emissive based on activity
        neuron.material.emissive.copy(neuron.userData.baseColor).multiplyScalar(0.3 + activity * 1.5);
        
        // Update glow
        neuron.userData.glowMesh.material.opacity = 0.15 + activity * 0.4;
        neuron.userData.glowMesh.scale.setScalar(1 + activity * 0.5);
    });
    
    // Update connections based on activity
    connections.forEach(conn => {
        const actA = neurons[conn.neuronA].userData.activity;
        const actB = neurons[conn.neuronB].userData.activity;
        const maxAct = Math.max(actA, actB);
        
        conn.line.material.opacity = 0.15 + maxAct * 0.4;
        
        if (maxAct > 0.5) {
            const color = neurons[conn.neuronA].userData.baseColor.clone().lerp(
                neurons[conn.neuronB].userData.baseColor,
                0.5
            );
            conn.line.material.color = color;
        } else {
            conn.line.material.color.setHex(0x445566);
        }
    });
    
    // Mouse hover
    raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
    const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(neurons);
    
    if (intersects.length > 0) {
        const neuron = intersects[0].object;
        if (hoveredNeuron !== neuron) {
            hoveredNeuron = neuron;
            neuron.userData.activity = 1.0;
            
            // Fire impulses from hovered neuron
            connections.forEach((conn, idx) => {
                if (conn.neuronA === neuron.userData.id) {
                    createImpulse(idx, 1);
                } else if (conn.neuronB === neuron.userData.id) {
                    createImpulse(idx, -1);
                }
            });
        }
    } else {
        hoveredNeuron = null;
    }
    
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

animate();
